scope: Append-only owner-attested reconciliation for an evidenced rejected Preview configuration request; preserve unknown-outcome duplicate protection.
riskAnalysis: Narrow configuration recovery only; current server-pinned technical review, owner auth, false flags and clean authority remain mandatory. External HTTP evidence is attested, not cryptographic proof. No inference or publication permission.

threatModel.assets: Immutable audit history, task authority, credentials, spending and cross-workspace isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Existing owner session and server-pinned exact technical review authorize recovery-only CAS. Internal agents, provider text and arbitrary submitted review hashes cannot authorize reconciliation.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged HTTP rejection, wrong workspace, altered old evidence, duplicate recovery, hidden credentials, unsupported provider results or unauthorized inference.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact narrow400invalid-target classifier, bound historical hashes and runtime, safe fields, clean shutdown, immutable append, atomic one-use consumption and unchanged paid-admission gates.

rollback: Revert reviewed source to previous paid-disabled Preview; preserve all old events, cancellation and appended reconciliation evidence. Do not revive grants or retry unknown deployments.

defects.rootCause: Configuration recovery treats a positive HTTP400 rejection as an unknown deployment and has no append-only reconciliation; Work also bypassed the existing correct REST builder.
defects.detectionGap: The invalid RESTtarget response was initially hidden by an unchecked result parser; recovered original native tool evidence establishes HTTP400 without another provider request.
defects.regression: Narrow rejection fixtures, current server-reviewed owner/controller denials, unchanged history and atomic one-use recovery tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use existing reviewed connector bridge and request builder exclusively. Preserve sanitized provider errors before parsing response wrappers; never retry unknown delivery.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing configuration records and controller only; no parallel journal, gateway, budget or service.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, image, infrastructure or provider permission changes.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged HTTP rejection, wrong workspace, altered old evidence, duplicate recovery, hidden credentials, unsupported provider results or unauthorized inference.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing positive rejection evidence or server review pin denies recovery. Unknown outcomes remain frozen; provider failure cannot imply success.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Malformed proofs, altered history, stale runtime, role/workspace impersonation and duplicate consumption are rejected in nonbillable fixtures.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor inspect implementation and focused evidence; technical criticism does not become human acceptance.
proactiveReview.recovery: Append receipt only after cancelled exact intent, clean shutdown and server-pinned review; never alter old unknown events.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused verification, STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and actual authenticated Preview archive precede paid readiness.
